subject.title: feat(grok): handle ask_user_question and exit_plan_mode client extensions

question: Should `acpx` expose these two Grok-specific callbacks on the public `AcpClientOptions` API, or should the feature be limited to an internal CLI implementation or a future generic extension interface?
rationale: The proposed callbacks add vendor-named conventions to a generic public client surface; repository policy explicitly treats new data-model and naming conventions as product compatibility decisions.

options.title: Approve the Grok callback contract
options.body: Accept the two callbacks as supported public embedding APIs and require harness documentation plus focused contract coverage.

options.title: Keep the behavior CLI-local
options.body: Handle the extensions for `acpx grok-build` without adding vendor-specific callbacks to the generic embedding API.

options.title: Define a generic extension API first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose a reusable extension-dispatch contract that avoids accumulating vendor-specific public options.

recommendation.title: Define a generic extension API first
recommendation.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose a reusable extension-dispatch contract that avoids accumulating vendor-specific public options.
